### Props

| Name               | Type                                                                                                                                | Required | Default                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rowActions`       | `Array<{id: string, label: string, icon?: string, type?: string, target?: string, props?: object, handler?: string, args?: Array}>` |          | `[]`                                                         | The host's own actions on each file row, declared the way a manifest declares any action (`open-modal`, `handler`, ...), and dispatched through the page's action runner with the node's `fileId`, `fileName` and `path` merged into an `open-modal` action's props (or appended as the node to a `handler` action's args). Folders get none. `icon` is an MDI icon name. |
| `linkedItems`      | `union`                                                                                                                             |          | `[]`                                                         | Rows that are not nodes of this folder: files the host joined from another object's folder. Rendered after the folder's own rows with open and download only. `note` (and its optional `noteHref`) says where the file lives.                                                                                                                                             |

| `rootPath`         | `string`                                                                                                                            | ✓        | —                                                            | The folder this browser is rooted at, relative to the current user's files root (`/Open Registers/Cases/&lt;uuid&gt;`).
